fusions.name: Quarry Named
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds. Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Kill Ordained
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Eye on the Prize
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Blooded Huntsman
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 10% for your next strike within 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
